title: MVDSV
wikitext:
MVDSV stands for "multi view demo server".
It is quakeworld server capable of recording MultiView Demos ([[MVD]]).
It is the most used QuakeWorld server nowadays (74% of QW servers - [http://www.quakeservers.net/quakeworld/stats/ quakeservers.net stats] in August 2008)

* [https://github.com/QW-Group/mvdsv Official homepage ]
